hero.headline: Four Decades of Manufacturing Integrity
hero.lead: Founded in 1979, Sahu Global Private Limited has grown from an artisanal textile exporter into a modern, technologically advanced garment manufacturing enterprise serving leading fashion brands across the globe.

story.title: The Sahu Global Legacy
paragraphs: In 1979, Sahu Global was established with a singular conviction: that Indian textile heritage could be united with international manufacturing precision. Over four decades, that vision has evolved through successive waves of industrial automation, strict global compliance frameworks, and digital supply chain integration.

Today, Sahu Global stands as a reliable, fully compliant apparel export partner. We do not simply fulfill cut-and-sew contracts; we act as a collaborative product development and production partner for sourcing heads who demand high fidelity, predictable deliveries, and complete social accountability.
From raw fiber evaluation and CAD 3D virtual sampling to lean sewing floors and AQL final audits, our operations reflect four decades of continuous refinement.

hero.headline: Built for Precision, Scaled for Global Demand
hero.lead: Our manufacturing footprint combines automated pre-production machinery, ergonomic modular sewing lines, in-house quality labs, and high-efficiency finishing units.

departments.title: Automated Spreading & Cutting
departments.desc: Tension-free automated fabric spreading machines coupled with computerized CNC cutting systems guarantee millimeter-level pattern accuracy and optimize fabric utilization.

departments.title: Modular Sewing & Assembly
departments.desc: High-speed programmable lockstitch, overlock, and flatlock machines configured into flexible modular cells, allowing seamless transition between complex wovens and knits.

departments.title: In-House Physical Testing Lab
departments.desc: Equipped with calibrated testing instruments to perform color fastness, dimensional stability, tensile strength, pilling resistance, and seam slippage tests before bulk processing.

departments.title: Specialized Finishing & Steam Tunnels
departments.desc: Vacuum pressing tables, automated steam tunnel finishers, and precision garment hanging conveyors deliver retail-ready presentation straight to buyer distribution hubs.

hero.headline: From Creative Vision to Production-Ready Tech Packs
hero.lead: Our dedicated technical design and sampling team bridges the gap between international designer sketches and scalable manufacturing reality.

capabilities.title: 3D Virtual Fit & Prototyping
capabilities.desc: Utilizing 3D apparel simulation (Clo3D/Optitex) to validate drape, tension, and fit on digital avatars, slashing traditional sample revision cycles from weeks to hours.

capabilities.title: Extensive Textile & Trim Library
capabilities.desc: Curated archive of over 1,500 mill-tested fabrics including BCI cottons, European linens, Tencel, viscose blends, modal, and recycled technical synthetics.

capabilities.title: Rapid Prototyping Sample Room
capabilities.desc: Autonomous sampling lines staffed by master pattern makers and sample machinists dedicated exclusively to fit samples, salesman samples, and photo shoot prototypes.

capabilities.title: Comprehensive Tech Pack Engineering
capabilities.desc: Detailed construction callouts, seam specifications, grading rule libraries, and bill of materials (BOM) creation for fail-safe manufacturing handoffs.

hero.headline: A Culture of Rigorous Verification
hero.lead: At Sahu Global, quality is not an afterthought at the end of the line. It is engineered into every stage from incoming yarn to export palletization.

pillars.title: 4-Point Fabric Inspection
pillars.desc: Every roll of incoming textile is inspected under standardized D65 lighting on roll-to-roll testing machines in accordance with international 4-point grading rules.

pillars.title: In-Line Statistical Process Audits
pillars.desc: Stationary roving QA inspectors perform hourly audits on sewing lines, logging defect rates to immediately correct machine tension or needle variances.

pillars.title: Pre-Shipment Final AQL Inspection
pillars.desc: Rigorous final batch audits conducted according to ANSI/ASQ Z1.4 (ISO 2859-1) AQL 1.5/2.5 standards before customs sealing.

pillars.title: 100% Needle & Metal Detection
pillars.desc: Every single garment passes through high-sensitivity dual-head conveyorized metal detectors to ensure zero metal contamination.

hero.headline: Market Intelligence Paired with Textile Innovation
hero.lead: We help international brands anticipate seasonal consumer shifts through technical finishes, innovative fabric weaves, and modern silhouettes.

hero.headline: Transparent, Audited & Certified Standards
hero.lead: To provide absolute assurance to European and North American buyers, Sahu Global maintains compliance alignments with leading global social, environmental, and technical audit bodies.

certifications.disclaimer: Note for Demonstration: The certifications and audit frameworks below represent Sahu Global's operational target standards and compliance readiness. Verified certificates and official audit reports are provided directly to qualified buyers during technical discovery.

items.name: OEKO-TEX® Standard 100
items.scope: Tested for harmful substances; certified safe for direct skin contact across fabrics and accessories.

items.name: Global Organic Textile Standard (GOTS)
items.scope: Strict environmental criteria along the entire organic textiles supply chain including chemical inputs.

items.name: Sedex Members Ethical Trade Audit (SMETA)
items.scope: 4-Pillar audit covering labor standards, health & safety, environment, and business ethics.

items.name: Business Social Compliance Initiative (amfori BSCI)
items.scope: Framework supporting international companies to improve working conditions in the global supply chain.

items.name: Worldwide Responsible Accredited Production (WRAP)
items.scope: Compliance with 12 principles covering local laws, forced labor, workplace regulations, and security.

insights.title: De-Risking Apparel Sourcing: Why European Brands Are Deepening Indian Partnerships
insights.excerpt: An analysis of how vertical integration, raw cotton availability, and strict ESG compliance are positioning Indian apparel manufacturers as primary alternatives for Western fashion houses.
insights.content: As global supply chains face continuous geopolitical and regulatory headwinds, procurement executives are recalibrating their manufacturing footprints. India's unique advantage lies in complete verticality: from domestic cotton fields to high-tech CAD sampling and export garment assembly. At Sahu Global, we observe that European buyers are no longer just comparing cut-and-make pricing; they are evaluating carbon footprints, ethical labor verifications, and digital prototyping agility.

insights.title: Understanding AQL 1.5 vs AQL 2.5: A Buyer's Guide to Quality Benchmarking
insights.excerpt: How Acceptance Quality Limit (AQL) statistical sampling works in practice, and why establishing clear critical vs. minor defect thresholds protects buyer margins.
insights.content: In international apparel trade, quality cannot be left to subjective interpretation. The ANSI/ASQ Z1.4 sampling system provides mathematical confidence. This guide breaks down sample size code letters, normal single sampling plans, and how Sahu Global's inline checkpoints preempt defects before batch packaging.

insights.title: The Transition to 3D Virtual Prototyping: Slashing Lead Times and Sample Waste
insights.excerpt: How digital fabric simulation and 3D avatars are eliminating 3 to 4 rounds of physical fit samples, cutting seasonal development timelines in half.
insights.content: Physical sampling has traditionally been the slowest and most resource-intensive phase of apparel development. By implementing Clo3D and Optitex digital avatar fittings, Sahu Global allows brand design teams to examine drape, fabric stretch, and silhouette variations on realistic digital avatars before cutting a single meter of fabric.
